name: Shipping
description: Synthetic Northwind companion with healthy11038 and blocked baseline requests11045 and11062; future recovery examples remain separate, with the11062 replay pending.

source.notes: Public synthetic training companion to Northwind; no real shipment or partner call is represented.

meaning.name: Shipping
meaning.description: Synthetic Northwind companion with healthy11038 and blocked baseline requests11045 and11062; future recovery examples remain separate, with the11062 replay pending.

concepts.label: Shipping request
concepts.description: A synthetic instruction to arrange shipping for a Northwind order. A request can be published and received without a carrier assignment; it is not proof of a shipment or delivery.

concepts.label: Shipping attempt
concepts.description: One numbered processing attempt for a shipping request using a pinned routing configuration. The baseline contains accepted and blocked attempts; future replay examples are stored separately.

concepts.label: Carrier partner
concepts.description: A synthetic routing destination identified by partner_id, with an enabled flag. It represents the training fixture's partner configuration, not evidence of a real carrier call.

concepts.label: Carrier assignment
concepts.description: A synthetic acceptance of an attempt by a carrier partner, protected by a deduplication key. Assignment acceptance does not establish physical dispatch or delivery.

concepts.label: Routing configuration
concepts.description: An immutable numbered configuration revision used when an attempt starts and by the routes published for that revision.

concepts.label: Shipping route
concepts.description: A time-bounded mapping from a shipper identifier to a partner within one routing configuration. Overlapping or expired routes are retained for diagnostic examples.

concepts.label: Message publication
concepts.description: Acknowledgement that a request message was published. Publication acknowledgement alone does not prove receipt, carrier acceptance, or delivery.

concepts.label: Message receipt
concepts.description: Observation that a request message was received by the synthetic shipping process. Receipt alone does not prove successful routing or a carrier assignment.

concepts.label: Shipping event
concepts.description: An indexed observation within a shipping attempt, with a sequence, clock domain, timestamp precision and a byte-range pointer to its immutable source log artifact.

concepts.label: Workspace snapshot
concepts.description: The synthetic fixture generation, active configuration and business clock used to evaluate current routes. The business clock is scenario state, not the current wall clock.

concepts.label: Northwind order reference
concepts.description: The Northwind order identifier to which the shipping request belongs. This is a declared cross-dataset reference, not a SQLite foreign key or an automatic join.

concepts.label: Attempt state
concepts.description: The recorded processing state of an attempt. A blocked attempt is not an accepted carrier assignment; the state describes only this synthetic processing attempt.

concepts.label: Message identifier
concepts.description: The same request message identifier carried through request creation, publication and receipt. Sharing it correlates observations; it does not establish completion.

concepts.label: Correlation identifier
concepts.description: A scenario correlation identifier used to relate shipping requests to synthetic carrier-gateway log entries.

concepts.label: Event time
concepts.description: The recorded event timestamp, interpreted with clock_domain and precision_ms. Time values from different clock domains must not be assumed directly comparable.

concepts.label: Clock domain
concepts.description: The clock domain in which an event timestamp was recorded; precision_ms declares its resolution.
